_comment: Manual input for scripts/fetch-contributions.mjs. `advisoryIds` are GHSA ids credited to you in the global GitHub Advisory DB; `items` are contributions the public API can't find (repo-only advisories, HackerOne reports, work under another handle); `excludeRepoPatterns` are case-insensitive regexes for repos to drop from the auto-fetched results.

items.title: Delete me — an example manual entry
items.summary: Anything the GitHub API can't surface goes here. Remove this object once you have real entries; an empty `items` array is perfectly fine.
